scripts.setup: test -f .env || cp .env.example .env; npx prisma generate; npx prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script | sqlite3 prisma/dev.db; echo 'Database initialized. Run npm run db:seed only if you want demo data.'
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace client" "npm run dev --workspace server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.test:workflows: rm -f /private/tmp/consulting-workflow-test.db; DATABASE_URL=file:/private/tmp/consulting-workflow-test.db npx prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script | sqlite3 /private/tmp/consulting-workflow-test.db; DATABASE_URL=file:/private/tmp/consulting-workflow-test.db npx prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma; ALLOW_DEMO_SEED=true DATABASE_URL=file:/private/tmp/consulting-workflow-test.db tsx prisma/seed.ts; DATABASE_URL=file:/private/tmp/consulting-workflow-test.db tsx server/src/workflow-check.ts
scripts.test:auth: rm -f /private/tmp/consulting-auth-test.db; DATABASE_URL=file:/private/tmp/consulting-auth-test.db npx prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script | sqlite3 /private/tmp/consulting-auth-test.db; DATABASE_URL=file:/private/tmp/consulting-auth-test.db npx prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma; DATABASE_URL=file:/private/tmp/consulting-auth-test.db npm run build --workspace server && DATABASE_URL=file:/private/tmp/consulting-auth-test.db tsx server/src/auth-ownership-check.ts && DATABASE_URL=file:/private/tmp/consulting-auth-test.db tsx server/src/cookie-production-check.ts
